subject: attn
title: ATTN.------INFO.PROJ.
description: Chart on book p. 36 (BK(NM)-12). ATTN (attraction) is the subject; INFO-PROJ (information projection) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), AFL (affinity alignment) and ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). From PROG-CONT: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). From SOC-RT-P: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INTR: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From AFL: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: VT-ATT (vibrational attitude) and V-SY (value system). From V-SY: PART (participation). From ALT-FT: HI-P (high purpose) and INFO-F (information focus).
